messages:
anya: quick sync  ran the export/import stress and still seeing a small % of leaked pins when exporter and allocator free interleave. repro attached in gist.

sam: can you paste the minimal trace?

anya: trace: exporter fd->export(), importer->mmap(), allocator_free(path=host-pinned) queues free w/ work item, exporter close(fd) triggers put, put races with work item -> sometimes detach happens after free but before allocator clears its live-map entry. pages become unreachable but still pinned.

jorge: sounds like two problems: (1) relying purely on refcounts across async workers is racy, (2) visibility ordering of metadata updates. both fixable with a lightweight handshake state machine.

ellie: agree. proposal: introduce HANDOFF token issued by allocator_free. allocator marks page HANDOFF_PENDING (atomic store) and returns token to exporter at export-time. exporter or importer must call handoff_complete(token) to finalize. free does not immediately reuse pages in HANDOFF_PENDING.

sam: important: nonblocking. free should not sleep. make state transitions atomic and use a background reclaim for timed-out tokens. metrics: handoff_issued_total, handoff_completed_total, handoff_reclaimed_total.

anya: for perf-sensitive small allocations (kv cache) add HOT_FASTPATH flag to skip handshake. validator thread periodically scans exported handles and force-reclaims pins exceeding threshold. hybrid mode reduces p99 impact.

jorge: token design: 64-bit opaque with allocator_gen, nonce, and hotslab hint (SHORT|LONG). sign with kernel secret for sanity checks. store token->page mapping in side table to avoid bloating page struct.

ellie: memory ordering: use atomic_store_release when moving to RELEASED and atomic_load_acquire when importer reads. also publish any metadata writes before transition. add kernel debug option to assert these fences on dev builds.

anya: test plan: unit state-machine tests; fuzz free/put reorderings; end-to-end tenant stress; process-crash recovery test that kills importer mid-handoff.

evictor-bot: scheduled job: orphan-handoff-scanner every 1h. labels: orphan_handoff_count, orphan_handoff_age_max_ms.

sam: userlib work: shim to call ioctl dma_buf_handoff_claim(token) and dma_buf_handoff_done(token). i'll prototype and run harness.

jorge: evictor changes: reclaim path should exponential-backoff per token and expose admin override via netlink so ops can force reclaim for customer incidents. add stolen_handoff metric.

ellie: include logging format in RFC: {ts, token, age_ms, pid, tenant, allocator_gen, device, action} for reclaimed/stolen events.

anya: ok folks I'll draft RFC with state diagram and example ioctls. aim to have PR by Fri so we can iterate next week.

sam: noted. ping me when draft exists, i'll drop prototype.

jorge: i'll add fuzz harness and fragmentation hint handling (SHORT_LIVED -> fast reclaim slab).

ellie: I'll write ordering notes and checklist for kernel reviewers.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
